newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek stocks end up, resistance seen at 1,290 pts.
newsitem.headline: Greek stocks end up, resistance seen at 1,290 pts.

text.p: Athens shares settled slightly higher on Tuesday with analysts saying the 1,290 level was a strong resistance level and the market would keep on trying to pierce it in the next few days.

"We saw the bourse's effort to break the 1,290 level last week. A second attempt was made on Tuesday. This area has proven to be a strong resistance level," said George Kissandrakis, an analyst at Northern Greece Securities.
Intra-day profit-taking was seen today, especially in bank shares whose shares, he said.
"I believe banking shares continue to be cheap in terms of P/E and earnings growth for 1997, he added. "Stocks of National Bank, Alpha Credit and National Mortgage look attractive."
Block trades in National Bank of Greece and National Mortgage Bank were performed.
Kissandrakis said technical analysis pointed to an upward market trend despite a weaker performance on Tuesday.
We might see a correction in the next two or three sessions, he said.

"We are going through the second phase of the rise, which is better than the first one where we saw only blue chips rallying. Now, it is medium capitalisation stocks that are on a bull run and this makes it an across-the-board rise," Kissandrakis said.
The Athens general share index closed 0.42 percent or 5.34 points higher at 1276.08 points from Monday's 1270.74, after opening at 1277.46.
Gainers led losers 120 to 105 with 30 issues unchanged on 255 traded. Turnover was 14.8 billion drachmas on volume of 5.3 million shares.
Investment shares closed 1.44 percent up, construction stocks gained 0.63 percent and banks rose 0.64 percent. Industrials closed 0.16 percent higher but small caps lost 0.48 percent.
Leasing shares rose 0.40 percent but insurance shares suffered the greatest losses closing 2.06 percent down.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted lower at 989.00-1,007.00. Shares of OTE telecom the underlying, rose 25 drachmas to close at 5,885.

The recently launched ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted lower at $31.20-$32.45. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted lower at 10,353-10,993 drachmas.
